subject: GROK-2: Negative Binomial Method-of-Moments + LOPEZ-2ND10 Signal Engine + Rung 3 Market-Anchored Shrinkage
body:
Grok: Outstanding work on GROK-1 (Empirical Elo residuals 7.5559, Lopez-2nd10 pass rate +10.36 pp [37.73% vs 27.37%], Poisson killed for NB with VMR 1.92/1.82, Mondrian finite coverage 90.5-93.2% on 2025).

Here is your autonomous workload for GROK-2:

1. FORMALIZE NEGATIVE BINOMIAL PROP/TD SINK:
   - In src/engine/data/ or packages/prediction-engine, implement the Negative Binomial count density parameterized by (mu, k) where k = mu^2 / (v - mu).
   - Wire this into touchdown probability modeling for Red Zone pass-TD (VMR=1.92) and TE target distributions (VMR=1.82).
   - Compare CRPS / log-likelihood against naive Poisson on the 2019-2025 test folds.

2. GRADUATE LOPEZ-2ND10 TO PREDICTION-ENGINE SIGNAL EXTRACTOR:
   - Package the validated tendency: immediate snap after 1st-down pass produces 37.73% [37.09, 38.38] pass probability vs 27.37% [26.18, 28.59] after 1st-down run (+10.36 pp elasticity).
   - Create the signal definition with strict scope: immediate snap only, regular season, excluding penalties/kneels/spikes/PATs.
   - Wire into in-play drive modeling and 2nd-down conversion props.

3. RUNG 3 PRE-REGISTRATION: MARKET-ANCHORED RESIDUAL SHRINKAGE:
   - You proved Gaussian market CRPS = 7.1167 beats Empirical Elo residuals CRPS = 7.5559.
   - Pre-register Rung 3 in docs/calibration-proposals/2026-09-19-rung3-market-shrinkage-prereg.md:
     Estimate Bayesian shrinkage: mu_hat = w * mu_market + (1 - w) * mu_Elo, where w in [0, 1] is fit via leave-one-season-out CV.
   - Test whether optimal shrinkage beats the market close (CRPS < 7.1167).

4. LINEAR WIND INTEGRATION (-3.007 yds/mph):
   - Formalize the linear wind passing degradation rule (-3.007 passing yds per mph of wind in outdoor/open stadiums).
   - Add unit tests verifying linear drop without quadratic penalty.
